name: European Commission, National Energy Regulators and ACER Network
description: European Commission, National Energy Regulators and ACER Network shape market rules, security of supply, infrastructure access and transition pathways. The immediate issue is gas security, infrastructure use, price formation and transition consistency. Its decisions or actions can change market access, investment incentives and asset utilisation.
urgency_rationale: Energy-security and transition decisions can rapidly redirect flows and capital.
